## Claims
- [computed] For \(J=[333,5^5]\subset\Lambda/I_{5,5}\), \(Q=J/A_+J\) is torsion-free and has ranks \((1,1,2,2,2,1,1)\) in degrees \(9,\ldots,15\), vanishing in degrees \(16,\ldots,25\). Thus \(\operatorname{Hilb}_Q(z)=z^9\binom52_z\). [artifact b5658ec18b84ad470751544a752f238dadd447fb7b1122a89a299a79e024042f]
- [source-backed] The stronger predicted structure is \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\); for \((a,b)=(2,3)\), it predicts \(\mathbb Z^{10}\). [source-6, lines 56-70]
- [source-backed] The lower-adjoined family \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\) minimally generates \(J_v\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 220-235]
- [proved] **Indecomposable-basis lemma.** Let \(A=\bigoplus_{d\ge0}A_d\) be a graded \(\mathbb Z\)-algebra with \(A_0=\mathbb Z\), let \(J\) be a graded ideal, and let \(G\subset J\) be a finite homogeneous generating set. If the images of \(G\) in \(J/A_+J\) are \(\mathbb Z\)-linearly independent, then they are a homogeneous \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(J/A_+J\). Hence \(J/A_+J\) is torsion-free and its Hilbert series is \(\sum_{g\in G}z^{\deg g}\).
- [proved] Minimality does not imply the independence hypothesis: for \(A=\mathbb Z[x]\), \(J=(2x,x^2)\), and \(G=\{2x,x^2\}\), \(G\) is irredundant but \(J/xJ\cong\mathbb Z\oplus\mathbb Z/2\).

## Strategy
The finite invariant exactly matches the rectangle-partition enumerator:
\[
1+z+2z^2+2z^3+2z^4+z^5+z^6=\binom52_z.
\]
It therefore matches the degrees of the ten lower-adjoined generators indexed by \(\rho\subseteq3^2\), and agrees with the stronger prediction in this case.

For the lemma, generation gives a surjection \(\mathbb ZG\twoheadrightarrow J/A_+J\): modulo \(A_+J\), only degree-zero coefficients in \(A_0=\mathbb Z\) remain. Independence makes this surjection injective, proving the conclusion.

The requested computed-case synthesis is established. No all-parameter torsion-freeness or quotient-basis theorem is inferred.

## Gaps
The obstruction is precisely integral primitivity/independence of the generator residues. The microcase above shows that irredundancy—even minimality—does not rule out torsion in indecomposables.

## Next
A uniform result would require an integral independence argument for the lower-adjoined Schur-generator residues in \(J_v/A_+J_v\).
